headline: SpaceX Launches Starship On Its Fifteenth Experimental Test Flight
metaDescription: SpaceX conducted its fifteenth test flight of the Starship rocket system in Texas, aiming for orbital maneuvers and attempted booster recovery.
aiSummaryBullets: SpaceX launched its Starship megarocket from Starbase, Texas, for the fifteenth test flight mission.
The mission objectives included completing approximately 14 Earth orbits over a 22-hour duration.
The attempt to control the landing of the Super Heavy booster was unsuccessful during this flight.
aiContextParagraph: On November 14, 2026, SpaceX initiated the fifteenth test flight of its Super Heavy-Starship launch system from its Starbase facility in Texas. Standing at 407 feet, the vehicle is the largest rocket ever developed and is designed with full reusability in mind to reduce operational launch costs. During this specific test, the company aimed to complete an orbital mission lasting roughly 22 hours, involving approximately 14 revolutions around the Earth. While the company has previously executed successful booster captures on three occasions, this particular mission encountered technical challenges as the attempt to land the booster was reported as unsuccessful. The ongoing testing program remains a core element of the company’s efforts to advance orbital launch capabilities through iterative flight experiments.
